verdict.rationale: Polar's docs comprehensively cover recurring subscription billing: automatic renewal and cycle advancement (polar-docs-10), configurable proration behavior at org/API level (polar-docs-12), plan switching/upgrades with immediate rate adjustment (polar-docs-19), failed payment retries and full dunning schedule (polar-docs-11, polar-supp-dunning), and a sandbox for testing full checkout flows (polar-docs-20, polar-supp-sandbox). Trials aren't explicitly documented in the evidence pack, and there's no independent third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs. Missing for 10: explicit trial-period configuration documentation, independent/hands-on verification of subscription lifecycle beyond vendor docs.
